title: Lance's Protocol
author: Lance Vowell
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r7yd9pw

steps.title: Draw equilateral triangle
steps.instruction: Draw an equilateral triangle with a base of at least 2.5 inches and one angle facing the top of the paper.

steps.title: Inscribe circle in triangle
steps.instruction: Draw a circle inside the triangle so that it touches each side of the triangle.

steps.title: Draw vertical center line
steps.instruction: From the top angle of the triangle, draw a horizontal line down through the center so it ends as it touches the base.
